reviews.title: Amazing quality monitor is a game changer!!!
reviews.comment: Easy to assemble, the quality of the screen looks amazing, "is a must have" if you have the chance and the glossy panel is just really good if you have your setup in a dark room, i feel that it can give you problems if you are surrounded for a lot of light, i appreciate all the features that the monitor offers and for the price i think is one of the best monitors that you can ask for
reviews.author: Jesus Martinez

reviews.title: Damn good
reviews.comment: He monitor is excellent quality and the colors are great and accurate. HDR is super bright and I hit a peak of 1386 nits. The stand is really good for the price and the true black coating is absolutely insane! If it stays at $550 it’s a steal even after the 2 weeks I’ve had it I’m still impressed with it.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.title: EXCELENTE PRODUCTO
reviews.comment: La compra fue super facil, el envio tambien un lujo, tardo solo 1 semana. vino sin golpes y en perfecto estado. Despues el monitor es una joya se ve demasiado increible
reviews.author: Leonel

reviews.title: Solid WOLED but not perfect
reviews.comment: A little darker at first. The HDR modes appear to not change the brightness between modes or have any noticeable changes of color or the cold/warmth. I stuck with HDR True Black 400 mode and switched to custom HDR and turned it up to 100. This noticeably increased the brightness without any washout. Monitor handles light better QDOLED but you still dont want it exposed directly, just prevents the weird purple hues and keeps black accurate. Overall it was good for its $549 price point.
reviews.author: Alex Alfano
